- **Credit vs equities.** HY OAS crossed 3.25% on Friday's data (3.31%), but IG OAS is only 0.85%. High-yield is warning and investment-grade is not. If IG follows (+5bp), that is a Stage 5 gate.
- **Nasdaq stress, not market-wide stress.** VXN (25.56) is about 1.4 times VIX (18.66). Fear is concentrated in Nasdaq-100 names. The bounce was also narrow: DJI −0.07% and Russell +0.25% against NDX +1.17%.
- **Rates and oil against the bounce.** The 10Y (5.136%) and Brent ($111.57) both rose on an up day for tech. That is a headwind for the next leg up.
- **News label vs news content.** The daemon flipped from CLEAR (0.0) to SHOCK (13.0), but the three items I can see are AI-capex headlines (Brookfield/NextEra $100B hub, Amazon reactors, AMD/Nvidia rally). ## TQQQ Read
- **Momentum:** RSI(14) is 37.5, neutral. It was 32.6 last read, so the bounce lifted it 4.9 points, and it is still 7.5 points above oversold (below 30). For a put seller, a bounce from near-oversold usually keeps premium (the price paid for the option) fairly rich. But a single green day is not a confirmed turn.
- **Market structure:** SIDEWAYS. Spot is 17.2% below the 4-week high ($85.32), short of the "more than 20% below" test (the line is $68.26). Spot is only 4.8% above the 4-week low ($67.43), far from the 30% needed for RALLY (about $87.66). The VXN leg of DOWNTURN is met (25.56 ≥ 25), but the price leg is not. Last read this was a marginal DOWNTURN call; the bounce has moved it back to SIDEWAYS.
- **Trend:** Mixed to weak. Spot is 5.14% under the 50DMA ($74.47) and about 9.2% above the 200DMA. It is 19.47% under the 52-week high. The cushion above the 200DMA has widened from about 5.6% to 9.2% in one session.
- **Volatility & premium environment:** VXN is 25.56. The 3x-VXN estimate gives about 77% IV, but measured ATM IV is 59%, so I treat the estimate as running hot by roughly a quarter. IV/HV of 1.24 (options cost about 24% more than the stock has recently moved) means sellers are paid a real cushion. SKEW (161.86) and VVIX (106.93) say downside protection is still expensive and volatility itself is still unsettled, though both eased. TQQQ moves about 3 times the Nasdaq-100, so swings stay large.
- **Put-selling context: CAUTIOUS.** Premium is rich (IV/HV 1.24) and VIX/VIX3M is in contango, which are friendlier than last read. But NDX is still under 30,000, TQQQ is under its 50DMA, high-yield credit has crossed its warning line, and the 10Y and Brent are both rising. The bounce is one session old. The lines to watch are a close under $68.26 or $67.43, IG OAS reaching 0.90%, and VIX above 20. The FOMC decision on Oct 28 is the sixth session from today, one day beyond the 5-session window.
